Abstract: Join **Jim** from the Matrix.org Foundation Trust & Safety team, as he walks through the progress the ecosystem has made in building a safer network, and invites you to join us in building the future of safety on Matrix. Jim is joined by special guest **Juliet** from [ROOST](https://roost.tools), and you'll hear about their tools **Coop** and **Osprey**. We'll talk about how matrix.org is using those tools, and how we're making them more accessible for Matrix servers. Jim will also talk about **Reporting v2**, a flagship project for the Foundation Safety team, and **how you can help**.
